summary: Revision 6 resolves the previously identified Dark NavigationItem surface conflict in the registered source contract. The documented navigation parent and default row bind to semantic.color.surface (#262626), hover to semantic.color.canvas (#171717), and selected to semantic.color.surface.subtle (#3d3d3d), while all four variant records retain 500 for default/hover/unselected focus and 700 for selected. The plan requires actual Figma parent fill and resolved variable-binding inspection plus side-by-side Light/Dark visual verification of default, hover, selected, and selected+focus; token values alone are not treated as rendered proof. The five-family scope, existing Button preservation, source-first design-spec review and handoff, targeted checks, independent code and rendered-design reviews, and runtime-evidence limits remain explicit. This plan verdict does not replace the fresh design-spec pass and handoff required before further Figma projection or claim current Figma implementation has been verified.
